channel.title: Raw Publication Date Test Feed
channel.description: Local fixture for testing parsed and unparseable publication dates.

item.title: Unparseable date: raw text should appear
item.description: Expected publication date display: Sometime after the purple moon.

item.title: Valid date: formatted local date should appear
item.description: Expected publication date display: the parsed timestamp formatted in local time, not the original EST text.

item.title: Missing date: unknown should appear
item.description: Expected publication date display: Publication date unknown.

item.title: Whitespace-only date: unknown should appear
item.description: Expected publication date display: Publication date unknown.
